mara_cs: Quick flag 1 LucidStack onboarding spiked token burn (~3.8x) overnight. Embeddings + rerank dominated, looks like a dev test harness hitting prod. Need a short-term safety plan and a single-slide QBR note.
ben_finops: Pulling per-route split and a 7-day projection now. If it's a stray test, this could repeat.
cal_se: Console dump: /v1/embeddings = 72%, /v1/rerank = 15%. Current pace ~2.1M tokens/day -> ~14.7M over 7d. Origin: automated test job using prod API key.
mara_cs: Immediate asks: 1) temp credit cushion + alerts, 2) route caps for embeddings and rerank, 3) block/rotate non-prod keys hitting prod, 4) schedule enablement + developer handoff.
ben_finops: I'll provision an 18% buffer and add alerts at 60% and 85% of that cushion. Will add token->$ delta for the QBR slide.
nina_enable: I can run a 20-min enablement with their devops: batching, sample-rate limiting, and dev-key best practices. Will record. Morning PT ok?
cal_se: Mitigation implemented: soft cap /v1/embeddings -> 850k tokens/day, paused the suspect API key, enabled short TTL caching for recent vectors. Monitoring metrics.
alert-bot: Created alert "lucid-onboard-burn-60-85" (ID: LUC-6001). Playbook suggestion:
```
1) add 18% credit buffer
2) set route caps: /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank
3) block/rotate non-prod keys using prod
4) enable short TTL cache for indexer
5) schedule enablement + 24h follow-up
```
ben_finops: Cushion provisioned and slide numbers queued. Added account note: "temp buffer until follow-up".
mara_cs: Owners: ben_finops -> cushion & QBR numbers, cal_se -> caps & key rotation (in progress), nina_enable -> enablement session. I'll reassess renewal risk in 24h.
cal_se: Caps set and key paused; watching dashboard. :thumbsup: 
alert-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 24h (1749995822).
mara_cs: If metrics improve we'll clear the renewal flag and include the playbook in the QBR packet.
